findings.reason: Both authentic original tiles are legible and contain no diagram. A concrete two-level schematic materially clarifies that conjugation acts inside B_n while stabilization changes the strand count, although both preserve the oriented closure. This explanatory benefit warrants a diagram independently of the complete proof.
findings.action: Added a native fenced TikZ schematic in final Remarks showing the two moves, their three closures, and the two oriented ambient-isotopy relations, with explicit conventions.

correction: Appended final Remarks only: conjugation and signed right stabilization on braids above, oriented closures and isotopy below, with n>=1, epsilon=+/-1, product order, orientation, inverse destabilization and empty-braid caveats.

diagram_math_checks.justification: For n>=1 and beta,gamma in B_n, top central beta and top left gamma beta gamma^{-1} both belong to B_n. The right node iota_n(beta) sigma_n^epsilon belongs to B_{n+1}. These are exactly the two moves of def-markov-conjugation-and-stabilization-moves; the caption includes both signs and inverse destabilization.

diagram_math_checks.check: Strands, crossing sign, and product convention
diagram_math_checks.justification: The standard inclusion uses the first n target basepoints and a new rightmost strand. The target generator sigma_n^epsilon acts on the last two target strands. epsilon denotes the exponent, rather than a sign inferred from an arbitrary drawing. The caption retains the local positive-half-twist convention and rightmost-factor-first geometric time. This is read from def-markov-conjugation-and-stabilization-moves and def-elementary-geometric-half-twist. No projected crossing or over/under convention is silently introduced by the symbolic schematic.

Each of the three downward arrows applies the exact local closure construction to its top braid. def-closure-of-a-geometric-braid identifies height 1 with height 0, concatenates endpoint-permutation cycles, and orients each cycle by increasing concatenation parameter. The caption explicitly states this orientation.

The left relation is oriented ambient isotopy between the closures of beta and gamma beta gamma^{-1}, proved in lem-markov-moves-preserve-oriented-closure-isotopy step 1.1. The right relation is oriented ambient isotopy between closures of beta and iota_n(beta) sigma_n^epsilon, proved there in steps 1.2 and 2.1. These are exactly current F1 and proof step 1.1; the theorem AC hypothesis supplies the countable-choice assumption. The bars labelled simeq assert isotopy, not equality or a homomorphism square.

The caption does not assert preservation of the axis during stabilization: supplier step 1.2 explicitly permits the isotopy to pass through it while page count changes. The diagram is restricted to n>=1; the caption records that B_0 has no stabilization and its empty braid is isolated, as stated in the move definition and current proof step 1.2. No framing-independence claim is added.
